scope: 49 terminal fit receipts only; the 2 walltime-killed fits and 24 comparison probes are excluded
tight_attribution_method: Each fixed/free fit event receives its elapsed wall interval since the preceding event; regime is event.tight for free fits or event.fit.tight for fixed fits. Includes inter-event bookkeeping. Untagged events and final search tail remain separate. This is event-attributed wall time, not exact pure tight CPU time or guaranteed removable cost.
